description: Record a direct cash sale in Manager.io for the Northwind Traders business. A walk-in customer has purchased 12 boxes of Chai tea and paid cash. Navigate to the 'Receipts' tab and create a new receipt. Set the Payer to 'Walk-in Customer' (do not create a new customer record, just type the name), ensure the bank account is 'Cash on Hand', and add a line item for 'Chai' with a quantity of 12. Create the receipt.
